TA0072.title: Communications Abuse Service Provider
TA0072.description: An individual or group that builds or operates SMS bombing, malicious cloud-calling, bulk verification-code reception, or illicit SIM distribution services for harassment, coercive debt collection, telecom fraud, traffic acquisition, and account abuse. Such providers combine modem pools, unregistered or fraudulently registered SIM cards, messaging APIs, voice trunks, and automated calling platforms into purchasable underground services, then rotate numbers, channels, and termination routes to evade carrier blocking. This role focuses on supplying communications infrastructure and services rather than conducting the social-engineering conversations performed by telecom-fraud groups.
